∀ (p : OracleTemplate.Rennala.Public),
  0 < p.n →
    ∀ (tau : Fin p.n → ℝ),
      (∀ (i : Fin p.n), 0 < tau i) →
        ∀ {Ω : Type} (g : OracleTemplate.Rennala.Point p.d → Ω → OracleTemplate.Rennala.Point p.d)
          (j : Fin (p.horizon + 1)) (seeds : ℕ → Ω) (r : ℕ),
          ∃ q,
            r < q ∧
              q ≤ r + (OracleTemplate.Rennala.batchSize p.v p.eps + p.n) ∧
                (OracleTemplate.Rennala.workerState p tau g j seeds q).iteration =
                    (OracleTemplate.Rennala.workerState p tau g j seeds r).iteration + 1 ∧
                  ∀ (t : ℕ),
                    r ≤ t →
                      t < q →
                        (OracleTemplate.Rennala.workerState p tau g j seeds t).iteration =
                          (OracleTemplate.Rennala.workerState p tau g j seeds r).iteration
